world.title: Egypt Moves to Defend Saudi Arabia as Iran War Threatens to Widen
world.summary: Egypt is contemplating military support for Saudi Arabia amid increasing Houthi attacks and potential U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran. The situation poses significant economic and security risks for Cairo, as Saudi Arabia is already vulnerable in the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict. Iran has identified Saudi refineries, data centers, and undersea communications cables as potential targets if hostilities escalate further.

world.title: Netanyahu orders West Bank closure, warns of major military operation after attack kills Israeli soldiers
world.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced a potential large-scale military operation in the West Bank following an attack by Palestinian gunmen that resulted in the deaths of two Israeli soldiers near Hebron. The operation aims to address escalating tensions ahead of upcoming elections, with plans for arrests and home evacuations as part of the response to the violence.

world.title: Karoline Leavitt Reacts to Trump’s New Appointee Lasting Just Five Days
world.summary: Karoline Leavitt commented on Katie Zacharia's brief tenure as White House press secretary, stating the role was not suitable for her after just five days. Leavitt expressed her willingness to assist former President Trump in selecting a new successor for the position. The controversy surrounding Zacharia's appointment has raised questions about the suitability of candidates for high-profile roles.

business.title: AI Law In India Soon? What Ashwini Vaishnaw Said At NDTV World Summit
business.summary: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced at the NDTV World Summit 2026 that the Indian government will release a consultation paper on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the coming weeks. The paper aims to gather inputs from both subject matter experts and the general public, ensuring a comprehensive approach to AI regulation and development in India.

business.title: Ashwini Vaishnaw's Big Promise At NDTV World Summit
business.summary: At the NDTV World Summit, IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw asserted that by 2028, India will have its own major smartphone manufacturers comparable to Apple and Samsung. He criticized previous Congress governments for stifling the manufacturing sector with restrictive rules and regulations. Vaishnaw's statement emphasizes a vision for India's growth in the global smartphone industry over the next five years.

business.title: Infosys headcount rises by 4,480 to 3.33 lakh in Q2 FY27; attrition eases to 12.7%
business.summary: Infosys increased its workforce by 4,480 employees in Q2 FY27, bringing the total headcount to 332,542 as of September 30, 2026. This marks a year-on-year increase of 551 employees. Additionally, the company's attrition rate has decreased to 12.7%, indicating improved employee retention. The latest figures reflect ongoing growth and stability within the organization.

technology.title: Rockstar Changed the GTA 6 Launch Trailer for TV Commercials and Here's What's Different
technology.summary: Rockstar Games has adapted the GTA 6 launch trailer into two distinct TV commercials for NBC as part of its marketing strategy. These commercials feature slight modifications compared to the original trailer. The changes aim to enhance viewer engagement while promoting the game. The commercials are currently airing, showcasing different elements from the launch trailer to attract a broader audience.

technology.title: Galaxy A17 4G users can now download One UI 9.0 (Android 17) update
technology.summary: Samsung has begun rolling out the One UI 9.0 (Android 17) update for Galaxy A17 4G users. This follows the recent release for the Galaxy A17 5G. Initially, the update is available in South Korea, with plans for broader distribution. Users can expect enhanced features and improvements as part of this software upgrade for their devices.

technology.title: Apple’s Rs 3 lakh foldable iPhone sells out on Blinkit in 5 minutes
technology.summary: Apple's foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, priced at Rs 3 lakh, sold out within five minutes of its launch on Blinkit in Delhi NCR. The announcement occurred during an Apple event on September 9, with the global release on October 23. Blinkit founder Albinder Dhindsa confirmed the rapid sales on social media shortly after the launch.

sports.title: Jules Kounde tries unusual recovery method in bid to make Barcelona’s El Clasico squad
sports.summary: FC Barcelona is preparing for El Clasico against Real Madrid this Sunday at Spotify Camp Nou. Defender Jules Kounde, currently recovering from an ankle injury, is a concern for the squad's availability. He missed the recent UEFA Champions League match due to this issue. Barcelona is exploring various recovery methods to ensure Kounde can participate in the crucial fixture.

sports.title: Virat Kohli ignored calls, messages after promising India comeback: Amit Mishra makes huge claim
sports.summary: Amit Mishra, former India leg-spinner, claims that an injury sustained during the 2017 T20I against England in Bengaluru may have prematurely ended his international career. He also stated that Virat Kohli ignored calls and messages after promising a comeback. Mishra, who has not played for India since that match, reflects on the impact of injuries in sports.

sports.title: Inside Badminton Champion PV Sindhu's Bengaluru Home: Mahabharata-Inspired Chessboard And Poolside Garden
sports.summary: Filmmaker Farah Khan visited badminton champion PV Sindhu's Bengaluru home, which she shares with her husband, Venkata Datta. A notable feature is a glass-and-marble chessboard inspired by the Mahabharata, depicting the Pandavas and Kauravas. The visit included interactions with Sindhu and her pet dog, showcasing the couple's unique home environment and personal touches throughout the space.

health.title: First Human Case of Shamonda Virus Reported in France, Patient Dies
health.summary: France has reported its first human case of Shamonda virus, resulting in the death of an immunocompromised patient. The virus, previously identified in livestock and transmitted by midges, has raised no public health concerns, according to authorities. Investigations into the case are ongoing, but officials emphasize that there is currently no identified risk to the general population.

health.title: Measles: Death toll reaches 1,214 as 7 more children die in 24hrs
health.summary: Bangladesh's Directorate General of Health Services reported seven additional measles-related deaths in the past 24 hours, raising the total death toll to 1,214. The update also noted 1,110 new suspected cases and 25 laboratory-confirmed infections. The ongoing outbreak has significantly impacted children, with 104 confirmed fatalities among the total, highlighting the urgent need for vaccination and health interventions.

health.title: Bharat Biotech slashes price of malaria vaccine MOSQIVAC by 40%
health.summary: Bharat Biotech has reduced the price of its malaria vaccine, MOSQIVAC, by approximately 40%. This price cut aims to protect an additional 1 million children and is expected to save $50 million under a deal supported by UNICEF and Gavi. The announcement was made on the social media platform X, highlighting the company's commitment to improving child health.

science.title: Dropped from a height of 3 km - and lost the vehicle: the test of the European Space Rider ended in failure
science.summary: On October 6, a test of the European Space Rider ended in failure on the Italian island of Sardinia. A full-scale model, resembling a minivan, was dropped from a helicopter at approximately three kilometers to evaluate its return and landing capabilities. Unfortunately, the vehicle was lost during the test, marking a setback for the Space Rider program.

science.title: Kobe University finds Kikai caldera slowly recharging with new magma
science.summary: Scientists from Kobe University have discovered that the Kikai caldera, a significant supervolcano in Japan, is gradually refilling its underground magma reservoir thousands of years after a major eruption. This finding provides valuable insights into the recharging process of supervolcanoes and highlights the importance of monitoring such geological features for potential future activity.

science.title: Hunter’s Moon 2026: When to see October’s full moon in Northeast Ohio
science.summary: The Hunter’s Moon will peak on October 26, 2026, providing multiple viewing opportunities for residents in Northeast Ohio. Skywatchers can enjoy the full moon as it rises over the autumn landscape. Local moonrise times will be available to help enthusiasts plan their observations of this bright lunar event throughout the weekend, enhancing the region's nighttime scenery.

entertainment.title: Thai Rapper Lisa's 'Tarantino' Music Video Squeezes in PS5 Product Placement
entertainment.summary: Blackpink star Lisa released her new Press Play EP and single "Tarantino." The music video features a reference to the PlayStation 5, highlighting her role as a global ambassador for the brand. The release follows significant anticipation from fans, showcasing Lisa's continued influence in the music industry and her ability to integrate product placements into her work.

entertainment.title: Amitabh Bachchan gives health update a day after announcing social media break to take strict rest, says he needs more time
entertainment.summary: Amitabh Bachchan provided a health update after announcing a social media break for strict rest. He shared on X that he was advised by doctors to take time off for recovery, expressing apologies for his absence. Fans expressed concern for his well-being, prompting messages of support. Bachchan emphasized the need for more time to recuperate fully.

entertainment.title: CM Dhami speaks to Daler Mehndi amid 'drunk' row, urges dialogue to end rift
entertainment.summary: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami spoke with singer Daler Mehndi regarding the controversy from Mehndi's Tehri performance. This conversation followed Mika Singh's call for an apology from BJP MLA Subodh Uniyal, who alleged that Mehndi was drunk during the event. Dhami emphasized the importance of dialogue to resolve the rift stemming from the incident.
